testResults.name: workflow-static-assertions
testResults.result: The workflow has pull_request and main/master push triggers with Python/config/tests and infra path filters; uses uv for lock, sync, test, and build; runs Ruff lint/format and ty; validates Bicep build/lint; and contains no MyPy invocation. All action references are full 40-character commit SHAs.

testResults.name: python-quality-and-tests
testResults.result: All local Python CI checks passed

testResults.name: bicep-build
testResults.result: The resource-group composition compiled without diagnostics

testResults.name: bicep-lint
testResults.result: The resource-group composition linted without diagnostics

decisions: The workflow is intentionally separate from publish-image.yml and performs no image publication, Azure login, what-if, deployment, or data-plane operation.
Both jobs use default fail-fast step behavior so a nonzero lock, quality, test, build, or Bicep command fails CI.
The workflow is path-filtered for Python, configuration, tests, project metadata, lockfile, infrastructure, and its own changes.
limitations: The GitHub-hosted workflow was not run, as requested; local command results do not prove runner or hosted-action behavior.
actionlint was not available on this machine, so workflow syntax was checked with static assertions only.
blockers: T028 remains dependent on CLEO task T020; CLEO task state was not mutated.
